fixtureManifest.recipe: authored byte-level wave-2 container writer (MRW block chain, RAF big-endian offset table, RW2 0x0055 header, generic TIFF marker); tools/reference/b10_raw_fixtures.py
fixtureManifest.vendorIdentity: generic TIFF dispatch only; no compression value in this build maps to an SR2 MIME type, so mimeType stays image/tiff

limitations: fixtures are authored containers, not camera captures: they carry no vendor private raw data, no MakerNote and no real preview, so a refusal is not evidence that a vendor layout is unsupported and a success is not evidence of RAW support; the MRW and RAF embedded blocks are parsed by the generic TiffParser, so tag naming follows the TIFF mapping and not any vendor tag list; the pinned build has no SR2 reader and no SR2 entry in TiffImage::mimeType, so SR2 rows record absence rather than presence; the RW2 preview branch is exercised only through the single authored preview, so the "more than one preview" warning path is not attempted in this batch; no B10 write suboperation is enumerated because the pinned registry marks mrw/rw2/sr2/raf amRead; ExifTool 12.76 is a secondary reference, not an oracle.
